turns.assistantText:
Resolved the checkout incident.

- Acknowledged and classified it as **SEV2**; published an identified-status update.
- Identified deploy **d-511 (API 2.4.0)** as the cause: its six-attempt retry policy without jitter or a retry budget amplified checkout load and exhausted API connection pools.
- Shifted the bad deploy to 0% traffic, then temporarily capped checkout at 100 req/s to drain the queue and protect the service.
- Rolled forward API to **2.4.2 (d-512)**, restoring two retries with full jitter and a 10% retry budget.
- Lifted the temporary admission restriction (now set above organic traffic at 1000 req/s) and published the resolved update.

Current health: all services healthy; checkout error rate ~0.13%, overall error rate ~0.18%, p95 ~153 ms.
